note: C10-A central source definitions. The four import sources (search_console, ga4, affiliate_clicks, make_commissions) take their lag and staleness numbers from operations_policy.json imports.* (single source of truth; not repeated here). Sources without an import config define their numbers here. access: local = derived from local data only; cached = external data already stored locally (reading it makes no call); refresh = how new external data arrives (never triggered by analysis).

affiliate_clicks.data_through_rule: cursor import: fully covered through the day before the last successful import

google_ads.refresh: manual (scripts/run_keyword_analysis.py --collect-auto-signals); analysis never calls Google Ads
google_ads.usable_when: a keyword has a stored google_ads signal observed within stale_after_days

threads_insights.usable_when: a matched observation near the checkpoint exists (T6.5 rules)

url_inspection.refresh: operations pipeline weekly check_indexability (inspect_on_weekly); analysis never calls URL Inspection
url_inspection.usable_when: the latest inspecting check_indexability run is within stale_after_days
